provenance: Vendor application images matched to live device metadata; not raw flash dumps
scope_note: Static comparison followed by a separate owner-directed live vendor-proxy capture; not an independent local provisioning test

accelerometer_probe_table.comparison: Decoded fields and strings; not relocated pointer bytes
accelerometer_probe_table.note: Identical decoded records; alternative probe returns zero even on match in both builds. Does not identify fitted hardware.

time_service.evidence: Static application/SDK branch comparison; no offline boot or DHCP/NTP packet test

receive_contract.evidence: Matched static branches; 18 existing isolated host receive/conversion cases, no physical local-NTP test

control_queue.evidence: 34-function static GNU byte/branch comparison; no host behavioral or physical queue/heap fault injection
control_queue.limitations: Other producers/timers can interleave; pending DNS callbacks remain; external helpers are not all recursively compared

dns_resolver.evidence: Scoped static comparison of selected resolver and SNTP callback branches; no DNS cutover/outage packet test

cancellation_ownership_comparison.evidence: Static GNU byte and normalized-operation comparison; no new device or host concurrency execution
cancellation_ownership_comparison.limitations: External helper identities are mapped separately; runtime thread-local cleanup, lock/allocator timing and physical faults remain unverified

maintenance_callers.evidence: Independent raw direct-call scans, recovered key references and GNU checks in each pinned app
maintenance_callers.limitations: Computed indirect calls and assembled keys are not excluded; installed correction and physical persistence/timing not read or tested

voice_presign.evidence: Static GNU instruction/branch and data comparison of both pinned applications; no additional host fixture or device test
voice_presign.limitations: External helper targets and initial allocator hooks mapped; not a recursive equivalence proof for all JSON/HTTP/allocator/multipart helpers

connectivity.evidence: Static GNU instruction/branch and literal comparison of both pinned apps; no additional host or device fault test
connectivity.limitations: Only selected app/getsockopt functions compared; external Wi-Fi/transport helpers not recursively proven equivalent, counters are runtime RAM and timing is not measured

recording_capture.evidence: Nine-function static GNU operation/branch/literal comparison; earlier nine SDK host groups are one fixture run, not new Standard tests
recording_capture.limitations: Physical microphone and dropout/stop timing untested; not a recursive equivalence proof of external helpers or hardware configuration; allocation ownership remains model-specific

outbound_inventory.scope: Static inventory only; dynamic returned URL hosts, computed indirect paths and complete offline boot remain outside the result

poll_result_lifecycle.evidence: Seven-function and two caller-region static comparison; no new host protocol fixture or physical experiment
poll_result_lifecycle.limitations: Computed references and runtime interleavings remain untested; does not compare the complete poll parser or foreground loops; dispatcher differences remain documented separately

settings_persistence.evidence: Three application functions and two caller regions compared statically; not NVS fault injection or a complete SDK comparison
settings_persistence.limitations: Physical flash durability, storage errors and all Standard SDK helpers remain untested; does not compare the full poll parser or boot sequence

multipart_upload.evidence: Recovered reachable application control flow and SDK HTTP writer; static two-build comparison, not new upload tests
multipart_upload.limitations: External HTTP/TLS, allocator, formatting and transport helpers are mapped but not recursively proved equivalent; prior host groups were Large-derived and were not rerun as device tests

voice_json_requests.evidence: Complete recovered presign/finalize application control-flow comparison plus separate host writer/parser checks

finalize.fetched_length_test: signed low 32 bits greater than zero

voice_json_requests.limitations: Application response branches are reconstructed around selected original SDK/parser/cJSON source; header storage/events, full cleanup and worker execution are omitted; external helpers are not recursively compared; no new device tests, allocation failure, concurrent cancellation or peer-receipt proof

voice_json_request_allocation.evidence: Previously compared complete request callers plus seven matching cJSON ownership helpers; real pinned cJSON under reconstructed host callers and injected allocator failures
voice_json_request_allocation.creation_error_cleanup: Delete root only; successfully created unattached children remain allocated
voice_json_request_allocation.limitations: Synthetic host allocations and custom allocator hooks, not ESP32 heap byte counts, actual fragmentation or physical TLS failure diagnosis; measured orphans freed only during fixture teardown

local_discovery.evidence: Seven paired GNU control-flow graphs; bytes checked against both pinned applications; no live mDNS tests
local_discovery.delegated_address: One copied station IPv4 address during first IP-event setup
local_discovery.limitations: No service-packet, collision, IP-change, heap/action-fault or other-release validation; absence from recovered setup is not proof against all indirect/constructed service registrations

device_key_selection.evidence: Five paired GNU control-flow graphs, descriptors and private embedded-material comparison; no credentials generated or live storage changes
device_key_selection.stored_key_validation: Successful read and first byte nonzero
device_key_selection.generation_algorithm: HMAC-SHA256 over formatted station MAC, 32-byte embedded key, 64 lowercase hex output
device_key_selection.limitations: No hardware-reset, migration, read/MAC/crypto/storage-fault or SDK implementation validation; existing keys can differ and override deterministic generation

reset_preservation.evidence: Two paired GNU control-flow graphs; separate Large SDK/HTTP/main-loop trace; no reset requests
reset_preservation.limitations: Preservation lists are attempted backups/restores, not guaranteed final state. No Standard SDK/caller equivalence, live reset, interruption or later cache/state/artwork recovery validation.

setup_metadata.evidence: Three complete paired GNU bodies plus nineteen SDK-reader/cJSON host cases; no live frame requests
setup_metadata.limitations: Scripted transport and reconstructed application response branch, not sockets/TLS/device/heap faults or complete recursive SDK/driver equivalence

local_backend_resolution.evidence: Ten complete paired GNU control-flow bodies and twenty-three isolated pinned-lwIP host cases; no frame or network requests

mdns.classification: First case-sensitive substring must equal the position six bytes before the end, excluding one trailing dot

local_backend_resolution.cache_and_pending_name_comparison: Case-insensitive; cache lookup precedes classification; same-address-type pending queries share the first selected route
local_backend_resolution.limitations: Stubbed packet send, timer and PCB allocation; no DNS response packets, elapsed waits, transport/TLS, device execution or complete recursive SDK equivalence

local_backend_dns_replies.evidence: Four complete paired GNU bodies; twenty-six pinned-source host packet cases
local_backend_dns_replies.partial_answer_state: A usable first answer can remain stored without callback after a malformed second answer; the tested next valid IPv4-only reply then fails
local_backend_dns_replies.limitations: In-memory packet/pbuf and callback stubs; no real UDP, chained pbufs, elapsed timers, backup-server scheduling, callback re-entry, TLS or physical device tests

http_connection_address_selection.evidence: Nine complete paired GNU bodies; two additional Large-only HTTP constructor/common-options bodies; no new host or device tests
http_connection_address_selection.synchronous_timeout_check: Elapsed deadline checked only after an in-progress low-level return; success returns before the check
http_connection_address_selection.limitations: Not an exhaustive runtime-write audit or recursive socket/select/allocator/TLS proof; no live IPv6, time measurements, connection-fault injection or application retry sequence test

image_cache_recovery.evidence: Nine complete paired GNU bodies; one unchanged pinned SDK helper and reconstructed application retry branches in 24 host case groups
image_cache_recovery.limitations: No vendor machine-code execution, real FAT image, wear-leveling/stdio fault injection, physical corruption, concurrency, interruption or durable recovery experiment

late_failure_cleanup.evidence: Three additional paired GNU functions; twelve host groups using unchanged SDK mount wrapper with modeled wear-level slots
late_failure_cleanup.limits: Conditional late-failure sequence; real wear-level driver, heap size, other cleanup paths, concurrency and physical effects not exercised

vfs_registration.evidence: Complete paired GNU registration body and previously compared mount wrapper
vfs_registration.limitations: Conditional static handoff; no crash, race, heap-placement measurement or real allocation-failure experiment. Prior injected invalid-state host case supplied a valid pointer.

rename_sync.evidence: Seven complete paired GNU functions; six unchanged-source RAM FAT12 case groups
rename_sync.limits: RAM whole-sector I/O and selected errors; not installed geometry, wear leveling, torn writes, physical power loss, concurrency or a complete target ABI/configuration match

allocation_preference.evidence: Three paired GNU allocation/free/preference bodies; no new host or runtime fault test
allocation_preference.limitations: Policy only; actual placement, fragmentation, common failure-handler behavior and TLS impact not established

tls_setup_allocation.evidence: Fourteen complete paired GNU bodies and eight unchanged-source host fault groups
tls_setup_allocation.calloc_region: INTERNAL | 8BIT; no PSRAM fallback in traced port
tls_setup_allocation.limits: Initial dispatch configuration and selected function bodies; not total connection memory, actual heap placement/fragmentation, complete external cleanup, TLS negotiation or cause of the observed Standard failure

tls_compiled_capabilities.evidence: Six complete paired GNU bodies and complete decoded cipher definitions/preference arrays; no new host or device fault test
tls_compiled_capabilities.limits: Compiled/preference inventory and selected ClientHello/HTTP construction paths are traced separately. No captured ClientHello, negotiated set, complete extension/record behavior or physical trust/certificate interoperability.

tls_client_hello.evidence: Six complete paired GNU bodies and fourteen selected-source host case groups
tls_client_hello.limits: Selected field serialization with host structures and compatibility macros; immediate HTTP/ClientHello construction is separately traced in tls_http_construction. No complete live handshake, TLS encryption, socket delivery, all extension helpers or negotiated interoperability.

tls_http_construction.evidence: Twenty-four complete paired GNU bodies; no new host or device fault test
tls_http_construction.limits: Recovered constructor and resolved option/submission helpers; not all TLS consumers, arbitrary memory writes, complete extension/record/socket behavior or physical interoperability

ota_write_lifecycle.evidence: Six complete paired GNU bodies and 22 source-level host case groups

encrypted_sector_gap.evidence: Static and host operation ordering; real flash encryption/partition state unknown

ota_write_lifecycle.limits: RAM storage, native host layout and injected allocator/partition/image-verifier outcomes; no physical flash, encryption, image verification, boot selection or whole outer-updater validation

voice_upload_acknowledgment.evidence: Five complete paired SDK bodies plus prior multipart comparison; 24 isolated real-parser host cases
voice_upload_acknowledgment.server_contract: Store complete WAV, return one final 200 with Content-Length: 0
voice_upload_acknowledgment.limits: Selected source parser/callbacks and reconstructed immediate application branch; no real socket/TLS, cancellation concurrency, full header storage/cleanup, outer worker or physical response test

http_response_cache_cleanup.evidence: Two complete GNU body comparisons and twelve isolated pinned-SDK/parser allocation cases; not live firmware execution
http_response_cache_cleanup.limits: One host run; full client teardown and actual ESP allocator not executed. External callees not all recursively compared. No cause established for live TLS allocation errors.

tls_lifecycle.limits: Static and native host X.509 evidence; no independent bundle updater identified by exact-reference census, no claim about future firmware

local_control.limits: Selected byte-checked handlers/wrappers with modeled JSON/HTTP, state getters, RTOS delay, restart and lower maintenance. No physical action or concurrent rendering proof; external callees not recursively equated.

raw_image_api.content_type_check: case-sensitive substring application/octet-stream in a 1-63 byte value
raw_image_api.limits: Byte-checked selected instructions with HTTP/cJSON/ROM, buffer getters, activity/LED, save/marker and render results modeled; no physical or durable-storage fault test.

legacy_multipart_upload.limits: Selected byte-checked instructions with modeled I/O, allocator, lower ROM/byte-search/format, state and storage/render outcomes. No physical reproduction or cause established for the historical persistent upload failure.

gallery_correlation.method: Same generation directory and non-user UUID across audio key, finalize panel URL and authenticated gallery original

limitations: Application downloads are not full flash backups or proof of installed byte-for-byte identity
Model and release differences are confounded
Same routes and shared strings do not prove full handler equivalence
Stock API hostname test-chain acceptance does not prove arbitrary self-signed trust
Minimum independent enrollment response, eFuses, flash encryption, recovery and custom boot remain unproven
Private API credentials, transcripts, original art, signed URLs and packet captures are excluded
